description: Requires simulationId and resourceId from simulation.create. Injects a bounded resource failure; returns updated state. Next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.recover_resource and simulation.metrics to confirm authoritative health. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.inject_failure

duration.description: Only with explicit type cdn_cache_loss or az_outage and CDN-capable network resourceId or resourceName. Integer 1–86400 simulation steps, not seconds; default 30. No random/node-pool selectors; omit for legacy quick failures.

type.description: Only cdn_cache_loss or az_outage, with an explicit CDN-capable network resourceId or resourceName; no random/node-pool selectors. Cache loss forwards misses; az_outage blocks the edge. Omit type and duration for legacy quick failures.

name: simulation.inject_failure
title: Inject Failure
